note: The XCF layer offset list is read from the input stream and controls the order and positions of layer records that are loaded.
The input-controlled top RGB layer record supplies the hierarchy offset used to locate tile metadata.
The input-controlled hierarchy level offset selects the level record for the top layer.
The top layer level record supplies an input-controlled first tile offset; this candidate sets it to zero while the layer dimensions still require one tile.

The zero tile offset is treated as successful loading without clearing or initializing the already allocated layer.image_tiles, violating the safety obligation that every tile pixel be initialized before composition.
After a valid indexed bottom layer creates a MonoLSB destination image, the uninitialized top RGB tile is drawn with QPainter and becomes the raster source.
Qt converts the image draw into raster spans that use the uninitialized source tile pixels during blending.

code: const uint *src = op.srcFetch(src_buffer, &op, data, sy, sx, l);
note: The generic untransformed blender fetches pixel values from the uninitialized top layer source image into the source buffer.
The MonoLSB destination store reads the blended pixel value derived from the uninitialized tile, causing the MemorySanitizer use-of-uninitialized-value target.
